inventory.notes: Every direct TCP connection passes InitiateSocket: PR_Connect becomes StealthIPv6Connect, which, with IPv6 declared off, fails a routable IPv6 destination like a host with no IPv6 route (network unreachable, nothing sent). A destination behind a SOCKS proxy is left alone: the proxy reaches it, not this host. One line of Mozilla replaced.
